notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {G}.
description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a land card.
Turntimber Sower triggers, creating three 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping the mana-producing permanent.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G} and sacrificing the three Plants, returning a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
